<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:NATIVE-027:40602393181 -->
## Verified resolution — important tests reviewed, direct closure

The implicit OS-opening fallback is removed. Production share policy has **no file-open or URL-browser adapter**; File/Files return Unavailable without launching handlers, and text/URL clipboard fallback requires the explicit `ShareOptions.allowClipboardFallback` policy. Public Calf packages and legacy entry points are retained; safer fallback is an intentional documented behavioral correction.

All **three original acceptance criteria** reviewed against **11/11 DesktopShareTest methods on each of Linux x64, macOS arm64 and Windows x64**, including six direct policy regressions:
- Untrusted `launcher.desktop` File/Files never invoke a clipboard/open handler; custom URI schemes are either unavailable or copied literally only when opted in.
- Actual `UnsatisfiedLinkError` injection and unsupported-host selection use the same production policy, identical outcomes/copy calls and zero native requests.
- Real readable+absent multi-file batch rejects before any native/clipboard operation; native dismissal, busy and failure do not silently trigger fallback. Clipboard failure is truthful and not retried.

Reviewed current production wiring and test injections, not just helper assertions. Existing actual macOS AppKit share cancellation/owner scenario also executes in this run; native service/provider/minimum-host/sanitizer gates are separate.

**Immutable verification:** [`03f6f510`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/commit/03f6f51068efec6bbd4d209b1844f8ef3de2dc5d), [CI run40602393181](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40602393181). All736 selected inputs verified byte-for-byte against the tested Git revision; before/after input maps, artifact digests, every XML hash, exact commands and runtimes reviewed. Tests ran fresh (not cached XML).

**Run scope is reported honestly:** 254 passing /255 executed cases in45 XML, plus3 explicit platform N/A. The complete workflow is **failed**, because Windows `NativeCacheIsolationTest.concurrentExtractionOnlyReturnsIdenticalCompleteBytes` exposed an independent cached-payload sharing violation. All important saver/share-policy cases above pass on Windows. That native-cache defect remains open for correction under IO-005; this closure does not waive it, BUILD-006 or release readiness. Linux/macOS jobs are successful and will not be rerun unnecessarily.

Original issue body/labels/history/attribution retained. No physical/minimum-platform, visible native save-dialog, provider IPC, sanitizer, API/ABI, dependency/legal/full-consumer or release certification; no packages/releases/deployments published. Persistent evidence/ledger follow this direct closure.
